rules.title: Exclamation marks
rules.text: Use at most one exclamation mark per piece. Tidewell sounds warm and calm, not loud.

rules.title: No hype words
rules.text: Avoid hype words. Say what the product does and let people decide.

words.why: Hype word. Tidewell describes what the mix does instead of calling it amazing.
"Game-changing" is an overclaim and is on the avoid list in section 1.3.
"Revolutionary" is an overclaim and is on the avoid list in section 1.3.
"Miracle" suggests a health promise we cannot support.
Comparative boasts need evidence we do not hold.

rules.title: No shouting
rules.text: Do not write whole words in capitals. Use bold sparingly instead.

rules.title: Sentence length
rules.text: Keep sentences under 28 words so they are easy to read on a phone.

rules.title: Reading level
rules.text: Aim for a reading level of grade 10 or lower so most readers can follow without effort.

rules.title: Alt text
rules.text: Every image needs alt text that says what the image shows, so screen reader users get the same information.

rules.title: Link text
rules.text: Link text must make sense on its own. Avoid "click here" and "read more".

rules.title: Text contrast
rules.text: Normal text needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background.

rules.title: Brand colours
rules.text: Large areas of colour in images should come from the brand palette.

rules.title: Logo size
rules.text: The Tidewell logo must be at least 120 px wide on screen so the wordmark stays readable.

rules.title: Claims need approved facts
rules.text: Every factual claim must match an approved, in-date fact in the library.

rules.title: Health and science claims
rules.text: Health, scientific and medical claims need written evidence and Legal sign-off before publishing.

rules.title: Expired facts
rules.text: Facts have a valid-until date. Do not publish claims that rely on an expired fact.

rules.title: Facts about to expire
rules.text: Check the publish date against the fact's valid-until date.

rules.title: Confidential names
rules.text: Internal project names and unreleased plans must never appear in public copy.

terms.reason: Tidewell is positioned as good value, not low quality. Say "affordable".
Our mix contains naturally occurring sugars, so "sugar-free" is inaccurate. Say "no added sugar".
The product name is "Tidewell Electrolyte Mix". Do not call it powder.
"All-natural" is a regulated term we cannot support.

facts.text: Each serving contains 500 mg of sodium.
Tidewell is made in Portland, Oregon.
Tidewell has been a Certified B Corp since 2022.
Shipping rates are calculated at checkout.

guidelines.text: Voice: warm, plain-spoken and confident, never boastful. Speak to one reader as "you".
Never compare Tidewell to named competitors.
Never shame people about their bodies, fitness or diet.
